The capped Runtime::prepare checks the cancelled control before Native selection. cancellation_prevents_native_load independently checks NativeLibrary::load with invalid bytes and cancelled control.

methods.model_translation: The validation boundary changed: zero Native caps return Invalid/native resource configuration at Runtime construction; Back deferred that check to Native backend admission. Nonzero unsupported caps are checked when Native is selected. SQL and Wasm can run. The exact code and field are preserved; the old construction/admission boundary is not claimed to be identical.

assertions.old: Actual Native trap, limit, denied, invalid-name, invalid-evidence, oversized return respectively Incomplete, Limit, Denied, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid.
assertions.exact: The native wrapper passes all six modes to guest_failure_persists. It calls terminal_target with native, then asserts Subscription::failure and saved terminal.exit exactly for every mode before and after clean reopen.

assertions.old: Failed inspection has empty results and exact Failed readiness.
assertions.exact: Exact Failed code from public Instance::read_status; status_progress 0; receipt absent; managed_selected absent; progress 0; saved request includes a valid captured cursor. After reopen, exact terminal/request/Failed status remain. Fresh retry has no receipt or selected output, empty history and progress 0.

After initial and post-reopen retry failure, all four global/tenant evaluation slots can be held together, a fifth fails, retained input returns to its pre-run value and the complete 8 MiB output pool can be reserved.

assertions.old: Reopen; a new retry still fails; result ID stays absent and checkpoint revision stays 0.
assertions.exact: Consume Fixture, drop Instance and Engine, then AnalysisStore::open. Known ID remains Conflict/managed attempt terminated without metadata change. New retry-error ID executes and has exact Failed terminal, no receipt or selected output, empty history and progress 0. The evaluate model has no checkpoint, so no receipt/output publication is the direct replacement for the old zero checkpoint counter.

methods.fixture_boundary: trap is a returned SDK Failed value, not a CPU trap. oversized at amount 0 returns empty IPC, which is Invalid because a decoded schema is absent. This is not a Native memory enforcement claim. No production process isolation is added.
methods.reopen_ownership: ManagedStatus, ManagedResult, requests and terminals are owned metadata. ManagedAttempt revision receivers do not retain Store or Engine. Explicit drop(instance) and drop(query) precede open. No shadowed Fixture retains the writer.
methods.additional_regression: native_overflow_keeps_checkpoint proves real Native Limit keeps a prior full output/checkpoint/context/commit, original instance and receipt history, including clean reopen. Passed native310 and host311.

assertions.old: SQL and Wasm stay usable with Native memory cap 1024.
assertions.exact: Runs actual SQL and Wasm selected artifacts under memory 1024; each produces value 7, one call, unchanged metadata and full returned pools.

assertions.old: Native replacement is Unsupported. Prior revision 1 and Wasm result ID remain selected.
assertions.exact: native_caps_keep_receipt installs/pins invalid foreign Native revision 2, then runs actual Wasm revision 1 under the cap. Host.update rejects with Failed(Unsupported) and exact root field. Data metadata and full ManagedInstance remain identical, history is the single original receipt, progress stays at its commit, full Wasm context/output/checkpoint/commit stay identical, current is true, same ID returns identical receipt without metadata change, and all four slots return.

methods.boundary: The capped Native image intentionally has invalid bytes. Rejection before loading is required; no shared-library execution is claimed for this cap test. Engine replacement shares the same Store intentionally; this test does not claim a clean reopen.

assertions.old: Use actual Native evaluate with cooperative cancel mode for cancel, revoke and expiry.
assertions.exact: All three causes use terminal_target(native). Manifest has exactly one native call. The source-built fixture sends E plus exact EvaluationContext.id from inside compute; the test asserts interrupted ID and three free slots while the fourth is held.

assertions.old: Cancel gives AnalysisReadCancelled; revoke gives Denied; expiry gives deadline or grant Denied.
assertions.exact: Cancel checks AnalysisReadCancelled. Revocation checks Denied/managed authority change. Grant is now+5 seconds; expiry uses its captured control and checks Denied/managed grant expiry. Revoke and expiry leave the caller control valid.

assertions.old: Join within 5 seconds and return all four permits.
assertions.exact: While actual compute is blocked on R, cancelled worker remains unfinished and still holds one slot. After R, one five-second timeout encloses fixture D and worker join. All four slots and complete free input/output capacity are available immediately after joined return. The source311 timing patch preserves the original post-cancellation join criterion.

assertions.old: No results, no activation result ID, no checkpoint advance.
assertions.exact: native_empty asserts progress 0, history empty, captured real attempt has no receipt, managed_selected absent before and after cancellation. No receipt is the current publication boundary.

methods.timing_boundary: The fixture intentionally waits for R to prove the API joins a live Native worker. The five-second guard starts at R and includes D plus join. Entry uses 30 seconds to observe actual compute after cold library loading; Back used 5 seconds to observe an activation metadata row before compute. No five-second cold-load or forced interruption of non-cooperative Native code is claimed.
methods.extra_host_stop: native_stop_joins passed host311: actual Native E, Host.stop unfinished before R, D plus stop join in one five-second timeout, exact stored Cancelled terminal, terminal revision equals ManagedResume.completed, no frontier/publication, joined Host serve shutdown within five seconds, all slots/input/output plus store lease returned.

assertions.old: An already expired grant gives Denied/package grant for Native admission.
assertions.exact: Prepares a valid source-built Native template, then calls public Instance::admit with a new ID and expires_utc_ns 0. Exact Denied/package grant is required.

assertions.old: No activation and all four permits available.
assertions.exact: Data metadata unchanged; no managed instance or attempt for expired ID; a single nonblocking Unix listener accept is WouldBlock, proving no fixture entry; all four evaluation slots and free input/output pools remain available.

methods.model_translation: Install starts no execution in the new owner. Public Instance admission is the corresponding authority boundary; no fake activation or Attempt is written.
